preconditions.description: Input integer n is within the range [1, 10^5].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= 10**9 for l, r in [(int(stdin.split()[1]), int(stdin.split()[2]))])
preconditions.description: Input integers l and r satisfy 1 ≤ l ≤ r ≤ 10^9.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(l <= int(x) <= r for x in a.split())
preconditions.description: Sequence a has exactly n elements, each within [l, r].

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in p.split())
preconditions.description: Sequence p has exactly n distinct integers, each within [1, n].
All elements in p are distinct.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (len(b) == n and all(l <= int(x) <= r for x in b.split()))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, output exactly n integers b_i in [l, r]; otherwise output '-1'.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and (lambda: all(1 <= p_i <= n for p_i in p) and all(1 <= i <= n for i in range(1, n+1)) and sorted(p) == list(range(1, n+1)))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the output sequence b must produce a sequence c = [b_i - a_i for i in range(n)] whose compressed sequence p matches the input p, where p_i is the rank of c_i in the sorted list of c.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (lambda: any(all(c_i != c_j for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n)) for c in [[int(b.split()[i]) - int(a.split()[i]) for i in range(n)]]))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the derived sequence c must have all distinct elements.
